name: @openagt/host-github-actions
description: A project's runs on GitHub Actions: each turn one run of the repository's own workflow, dispatched from here and read back once it ends, the work on a branch it pushes. A plugin kept per project, off until switched on; "Run on" offers it beside this computer.

scripts.build: cp ../../.github/workflows/openagent-agent.yml workflow.yml && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build -c dashboard/vite.config.ts
scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node ../../scripts/test-node.mjs && cd dashboard && vitest run
